# HL7 IG Bundle Ingester

> Java tool that converts HL7 IG-publisher output bundles into
> AsciiDoc topic fragments for ingestion into the corpus topic
> library.

## Overview

- [About](https://ike.network/hl7-ig-corpus-example/ingest/index.html.md)
